purpose: Compose the already frozen A/B skip-state and native-full local-response experiments into a cross-transition response-state transport test.
transformation: For each donor update, receiver and numeric CSRG role, compute D_U R = J_native_full - J_skip and compare J_skip and J_native_full against their exact own-state plus-one outcomes.
strict_support: Every nonzero numeric response changes, J_native_full is strictly closer to the native-full exact plus-one outcome, and J_skip is strictly closer to the skip-state exact plus-one outcome in all four donor-receiver contexts.
falsification: The response objects remain byte-identical across the actual native transition, or endpoint registration provides no residual improvement.
mixed: The response changes and endpoint registration has some predictive value, but the strict all-role transport criterion is not satisfied.
categorical_rule: Categorical values are never subtracted or averaged; only raw outcomes and transition masks are compared.
scope: One actual native transition at each of two matched receiver states under two exact realized donor updates; h=1 only.
